name: boss-11
about: Boss Rush: Patrimony Phantom, second version (2026-11-16): a deep hood over its whole head with two violet eye slits, its body split down the middle (the left half a bone-white skeleton, the right half dark steel armour), a torn black cloak, a violet-edged cleaver in its right hand. The first version (boss-11-v1.json) showed a bare chrome skull with glowing eyes over a metal ribcage, which could read as a famous film robot's endoskeleton. Tripo H3.1 from concept boss11b-phantom-sd-1; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound to the bone that owns it; the cloak hangs from the chest.
bar: the game's one quality bar for a hero model (2026-11-17): 2048 px colour, 1024 px other maps, about 55K triangles
